devnotes.summary: Provides the dry-matter production submodel for CERES-Wheat.
devnotes.remarks: This simplified module supports parameterisation. The soil-water deficit factor is a nonlinear function of the transpiration ratio (Ferreyra 2003), and potential biomass production is limited by soil-water availability or specific leaf nitrogen. Temperature effects use the Wang-Engel response function. The module also includes an empirical representation of the atmospheric CO2 effect.
